steps.why: Use a five-minute bucket strictly in the past so immediate oracle self-replay can compare the same raw minute-precision timestamp.
steps.sql: UPDATE valve_schedules SET fire_at=strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:','now','-1 minute') || printf('%02dZ', 5 * (CAST(strftime('%M','now','-1 minute') AS INTEGER) / 5)) WHERE device_eui='A840410000000002'
